summary: A toolbar with roving focus, built from an item list: buttons, icon toggles, separators, an input and links.

props.name: items
props.description: A discriminated union. `{ label }` is a button (plus optional `icon`, `iconOnly`, `disabled`, `onClick`). `{ type: "separator" }` divides. `{ type: "toggles", options }` is an icon toggle group. `{ type: "input", label }` and `{ type: "link", label, href }` are the remaining kinds.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the bar and every control inside it. The bar takes one step more than its controls.

props.name: animated
props.description: The press-scale on buttons and toggles. Turn it off for static controls, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.
